error: RuntimeError: C3 Gamma support/group coverage differs from seed606 Mode-A OFF

diagnostic_review.finding: seed909 Stage2 有效面积杂波与预注册统计可比性均通过。C2 的 3 个 Gamma groups 与 seed606 Mode-A OFF support 完全一致。C3 两边均有 117 个 group，group key 完全一致且全部 status=OK、truth_used_in_estimator=false；但严格冻结的每组 support_count 完全相等门不通过：116/117 groups 不同，support 总数从 95803 变为 92859。
diagnostic_review.correction: 这不是缺失群组或生产运行失败：C3 seed909 Production 分支 returncode=0，track audit、CSI tap、CFAR valid-CUT 与 Gamma tap 均通过。support_count 是 Robust DDC 在该 realization 上得到的有效拟合样本数，会随独立杂波 realization 变化；本次预注册门要求完全一致，故按规则停止，不放宽门槛、不运行 seed606 六个评价分支，也不报告性能差值。

limitations: Independent seed909 Stage2 reference was generated with effective area clutter and passed the frozen power/CV/correlation/noise tolerance gate.
C2 reference support matched, but C3 support_count differed for 116 of 117 matching groups; the preregistered exact-support gate stopped evaluation.
No seed606 OFF/ON/TO independent-reference Production branches were run, so this secondary provides no task-performance comparison.
Pfa remains NOT_EVALUABLE; no statistical significance or real-airborne deployability claim is made.

preflight_failures.finding: RuntimeError: effective Stage2 area-clutter gate failed
preflight_failures.diagnostic: seed909 本身的 Stage2 报告通过面积杂波 gate（390 packets、1,952,655 samples、实测均功率 0.0225120348144）。本次 combined gate 失败的原因是 runner 错读了 seed606 的 A0_OFF 报告；该角色复用已生成背景，因此其本地注入数为 0，不能代表 seed606 面积杂波注入源。
